entities.title: Deep Claim
entities.summary: An original asteroid-mining platformer for the browser, made in Godot 4: collect ore on limited oxygen and jetpack fuel, refill in the buggy, and drive out before each shaft caves in.
entities.purpose: Holds the whole game: the Godot project in godot/, the page around the web export in godot/web_shell/ and web/, the Worker that serves it in worker/, the Worker's tests in test/ and the shaft-map builder in tools/. It is one npm project and one Cloudflare Worker.
boundaries: The sign-in is icelander.net's; the Worker checks it with the shared library in vendor/icelander-auth/, never edited here.
The game keeps nothing on the server: no database, no high-score table. The best haul is saved in the player's browser.
